CVE-2014-1545.title: Mozilla Netscape Portable Runtime (NSPR) before 4.10.6 allows rem ...

CVE-2015-2613.title: Unspecified vulnerability in Oracle Java SE 7u80 and 8u45, and Ja ...

CVE-2015-2730.title: Mozilla Network Security Services (NSS) before 3.19.1, as used in ...

CVE-2016-1979.title: Use-after-free vulnerability in the PK11_ImportDERPrivateKeyInfoA ...

CVE-2017-7781.title: An error occurs in the elliptic curve point addition algorithm th ...
